appraisal_events.evidence: Il écoutait mes explications, me répondait avec précision... j'étais comme un homme qui, ne pouvant ouvrir les yeux depuis plusieurs jours, fait appeler un médecin lequel avec adresse et douceur lui écarte la paupière, lui enlève et lui montre un grain de sable; le malade est guéri et rassuré.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator elevates Saint-Loup through an extended simile comparing him to a skilled, gentle physician who instantly resolves the narrator's suffering, presenting his competence and composure as directly transformative.

status_effects.explanation: Saint-Loup is locally elevated as competent, precise, and reassuring, framed by the narrator as a figure whose alert efficacy calms and cures.
The narrator's anguish dissolves under Saint-Loup's handling of the matter; he moves from unable to bear a moment of suffering to feeling life as beautiful and himself overflowing with strength.
